verdict.rationale: Whether a registrar's own source is published under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only Namecheap-published Terraform provider and Go SDK READMEs on GitHub. These are ecosystem client tooling with no license stated, not the registrar product's own source, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
